intro: Gurukul Kota and {{nameB}} both sit in Kota, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Gurukul Kota vs Modi Institute of Management & Technology is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Gurukul Kota vs Modi Institute of Management & Technology for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: We cannot yet recommend Gurukul Kota on fees or placements, because our live records do not carry a MBA / PGDM programme row for it. Confirm the official site before you apply.
Choose Modi Institute of Management & Technology if you want a recorded fee of ₹55,000, and an admission route through Rajasthan MAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kota.

One important gap: our live records do not yet carry programme, fee or placement rows for Gurukul Kota on this MBA / PGDM page, even though the comparison is published. Read the table with that gap in mind.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records do not yet list a quotable recorded programme fee for Gurukul Kota on this course, so treat any figure on third-party sites as unverified until the official notice is checked.

Our records show ₹55,000 as a tuition figure for MBA at Modi Institute of Management & Technology. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not have a 2020-or-later flagship placement record for Gurukul Kota on this page.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Modi Institute of Management & Technology here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Gurukul Kota on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.

Modi Institute of Management & Technology is listed on our records with Rajasthan MAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Kota, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Until Gurukul Kota has a recorded MBA / PGDM programme and fee on this page, treat it as a lead to verify, not as a college you can rank from our table alone.
Modi Institute of Management & Technology is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded MBA / PGDM offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
